formulas.name: Barter buy price multiplier
formulas.source: Game8 Fallout: New Vegas Barter table (a secondary source; the wiki page could not be fetched)
formulas.note: 155% of base value at Barter 0 down to 110% at Barter 100, linear; the table's 20-point rows (146, 137, 128, 119) all fit.

formulas.name: Barter sell price multiplier
formulas.source: Game8 Fallout: New Vegas Barter table (a secondary source; the wiki page could not be fetched)
formulas.note: 45% of base value at Barter 0 up to 90% at Barter 100, linear; the table's 80-point row says 91 where the line gives 81, treated as a typo.
